chunks: Zurārah heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying:
There is no harm in what the miʿrāḍ kills, if it is only made for that purpose.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمِعْرَاضُ: a hunting tool or projectile used to kill game
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator reporting the hadith
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.لِذَلِكَ: for that purpose, meaning specifically for hunting

ai.seo_question: Is an animal killed by a miʿrāḍ lawful if the tool was made specifically for hunting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning game killed by a miʿrāḍ, a hunting implement. It indicates permissibility when the instrument is specifically fashioned for hunting, making it relevant to the fiqh of lawful slaughter and hunted animals.
